searchText: MSRP $331,410. All New Diesel Super C from Entegra Coach! The 2026 Entegra Coach Accolade XT Features Customer Value Package More About This RV The 29T is approximately 30 feet 2 inches in length and features Ford® F550 4X4 chassis and a Ford 6.7L Power Stroke V8 Turbo diesel engine. This beautiful RV features the Customer Value Package which includes a One-piece, seamless, fiberglass rear cap with auxiliary flood lights; Automotive-bonded, panoramic window in front cap with power shade; 15,000 BTU A/C unit with heat pump and second 13,500 BTU A/C unit; Electric, wind-sensing, legless patio awning with LED lights; 2,000W pure sine wave inverter; 200W solar panel with dual controller; Starlink satellite internet system; Backup and side-view cameras; Two-burner induction cooktop; Residential refrigerator; Convection microwave. The Entegra Accolade XT boasts an impressive list of standard features including a one-piece fiberglass front cap, dual pane tinted windows, exterior entertainment center, ball-bearing drawer guides, raised panel hardwood cabinetry, deluxe hidden cabinet hinges, solid surface countertops, water filtration system, and much more.
